spell.cursespells.a_call_beyond.guide: Raise both hands and tear a hole in the sky. Lights spill out of it, arc away, and burst across the ground around you.
spell.cursespells.all_vanity.guide: Opens circle after circle in the air overhead. For thirty seconds each fires a beam at the nearest enemies in sight within fifty blocks: six shots a quarter-second apart, then a one-second pause, over and over.
spell.cursespells.blade_of_judgment.guid: While channelled, a circle opens in the sky and drives eight fifteen-block swords wreathed in blue fire to where you look, one every half second. Each tears a crater and throws up crystal pillars.
spell.cursespells.catastrophe.guide: Tear open a cyclone of blue soulfire where you are looking. It drags everything within ten blocks into itself, holds it spinning in the air, and grinds it down with poison, wither, fire, frost, soul burning and a curse.
spell.cursespells.chain_curse.guide: Looses a stream of blue fire and souls at your target that leaps on from enemy to enemy. Every victim is cursed and struck by random afflictions.
spell.cursespells.cursed_arrow.guide: Three burning arrows loosed one after another. Each carries the curse, and something else besides.
spell.cursespells.cursed_breath.guide: Five seconds of blue fire poured out of a ring at your fingertips. Nothing it touches keeps its armour.
spell.cursespells.cursed_charge.guide: Calls up a phantom greatsword and rides it forward, over ground or through the air.
spell.cursespells.cursed_claw.guide: Four lines drawn across the air. Everything nearby falls toward them, and then the air lets go.
spell.cursespells.cursed_crush.guide: Bring both arms down, and six holes open in a line ahead - crystal bursting out of each.
spell.cursespells.cursed_eye.guide: Open a cursed eye upon the world. Every hostile creature within 50 blocks is revealed and cursed, unable to heal.
spell.cursespells.cursed_hand.guide: A vast hand tears out of the ground, flies forward and closes on whatever it reaches.
spell.cursespells.cursed_heart.guide: Tear out eighteen points of your own life and take back a shield, hardened skin, knitting flesh and a long immunity to fire.
spell.cursespells.cursed_lung.guide: Fills your chest with something that does not need air. The dark parts water and the deep stop mattering for a while.
spell.cursespells.cursed_orb.guide: The ground around you turns and burns for ten seconds. Armour is no help to anything caught in it.
spell.cursespells.cursed_rage.guide: Tears the ground open along three lines at once, throwing everything skyward.
spell.cursespells.cursed_sabbath.guide: Six remnants rise in a ring around you. What is left of them still remembers how to cast.
spell.cursespells.cursed_scar.guide: Five gashes tear outward through the ground, throwing the earth up as they run.
spell.cursespells.cursed_slash.guide: Hurl a horizontal blade of cursed soulfire that pierces everything in its path, dealing flat damage that ignores armour and inflicting Wither and Cursed.
spell.cursespells.cursed_strike.guide: Hurls the greatsword spinning through one enemy after another, then calls it home.
spell.cursespells.dagger_of_obsession.gu: Fan out ten glowing daggers, leap up and back, and fan out ten more in mid-air. A beat later they fly, each hunting down its own enemy.
spell.cursespells.flame_of_stagnation.gu: A blue fireball thrown flat and fast. It bursts where it lands.
spell.cursespells.flames_of_fury.guide: With a dragon's roar, opens a circle underfoot and sends four lines of pale-blue hellfire pillars racing outward at once, four pillars each - first in a cross, then on the diagonals.
spell.cursespells.frenzy_plant.guide: Five lines of root, burrowing out ahead of you. They break the surface, arch over what is standing there, and bury themselves again.
spell.cursespells.homing_soulmass.guide: Conjure a wreath of blue wither skulls above your head. After a moment they lock on to your target and hunt it down, each bursting into cursed soulfire on contact.
spell.cursespells.inferno.guide: Wreathe yourself in an inferno. For twenty seconds, pillars of blue soulfire erupt beneath enemies within twenty blocks, searing them with wither, curse and soul burning.
spell.cursespells.leaf_storm.guide: A column of wind and torn foliage, thrown forward. It does not chase - it simply keeps going.
spell.cursespells.pillar_of_sin.guide: A sigil opens overhead and drives a burning spike into the earth. It beats out a shockwave every two seconds until it shatters.
spell.cursespells.primal_seed.guide: A seed thrown in an arc. Where it lands the ground answers, and what grows there knows whose side it is on.
spell.cursespells.rage_awakened.guide: Smash both arms into the ground, hurling enemies sky-high as a six-pointed crack splits open. A beat later lightning strikes each tip, tearing rifts that spit motes of light.
spell.cursespells.ray_of_punishment.guid: A lash of soulfire that runs straight through everything in its path. At its full strength it leaves the struck withering and burning.
spell.cursespells.shadow_dive.guide: Spin skyward like a Riptide trident, flinging away all around, then blink to your target and drive into it still spinning, bursting in blue fire and lightning that curses all it catches.
spell.cursespells.silent_waltz.guide: Wind up, then bring a scythe of pale light around you in a single turn. Everything the blade passes is cut, withered, cursed and frozen.
spell.cursespells.skyfall.guide: While channelled, circles open in the sky behind you and rain meteors wrapped in blue smoke on the ground within twenty blocks of where you look.
spell.cursespells.soul_stream.guide: For three seconds a core of souls whirls before the caster, drinking in blue fire, crystal and souls like a black hole. Then it breaks loose as a torrent as thick as a body, running straight through everything it touches. While it pours, the caster can barely move and their gaze turns only slowly.
spell.cursespells.stagnant_spiral.guide: Two phantom blades circle you, cutting everything they pass through.
spell.cursespells.the_sky_and_cosmos_are: THE SKY AND COSMOS ARE ONE
Night falls and a spiral of blue fire lifts you up. A vortex onto space opens over the ground ahead, rains meteors for eight seconds, then lets fall a vast eye that leaves a burning crater.
spell.cursespells.wandering_grudge.guide: Release a drifting orb of pale soulfire that seeks out your target and bursts, inflicting Wither, Cursed, Frost and Soul Burning on everything nearby.
spell.dacxirons.acid_ball_spell.guide: Unleash a poisonous flaming ball upon your enemies
spell.dacxirons.bloody_arrow.guide: Projectile full of dread and gore, inflicts bleeding
spell.dacxirons.crimson_oath.guide: Reduce your health critically and begin to bleed, but your blood empowers your spells
spell.dacxirons.eldritch_slash.guide: Unleash an uninterruptible slash infused by Kamath himself
spell.dacxirons.fairys_wish_spell.guide: Your wish has been granted, receive 2 randomly chosen positive effects
spell.dacxirons.summon_pyro_knight.guide: A blazing guard comes to your defense
spell.dacxirons.summon_weakness.guide: These spider-like critters come to your bloody aid
spell.dacxirons.summonkamath.guide: Summon the eldritch champion, Kamath himself
spell.dacxirons.sunleia_beam.guide: A beam straight from the depths of the burning sun
spell.dacxirons.suns_wrath.guide: Summon an AOE embodiment of Sunleia's wrath, cursing those who enter
spell.dacxirons.triple_fireball_spell.gu: Unleash three consecutive balls of fire
spell.darkermagic.summoned_sculk_centipe: Summon a Sculk Centipede from the Otherside
spell.darkermagic.summoned_sculk_snapper: Summon a Sculk Snapper from the Otherside
spell.darkermagic.summoned_shattered.gui: Summon a Shattered from the Otherside
spell.darkermagic.summoned_warden.guide: Summon a Warden from the deep depths
spell.frierenvoid.black_zoltraak.guide: A white flower seal fires a black beam with flowing ink and a grainy pale rim. With this spell selected, press the Cycle Zoltraak Mode key (default: Left Shift; rebind in Controls) to cycle Single / Rapid / Large. Large shots break ordinary terrain and split against resistant blocks. In Rapid mode, hold the cast button to keep firing guided shots; continued fire consumes extra mana. Large mode consumes twice the base cast mana.
spell.frierenvoid.defense.guide: Deploy a front-facing hexagonal barrier for 4 seconds. It follows your aim and absorbs arrows and spell projectiles. Excess damage passes through; rear and environmental damage are not blocked.
spell.frierenvoid.singularity.guide: A palm-sized core grows progressively as it rises into the sky. Air curves into a wide luminous disk, which draws in enemies and real terrain. Absorbed blocks vanish without drops. A brilliant flash and shockwaves end the spell. Allies, pets and block entities are protected. Terrain absorption can be disabled in server settings.
spell.frierenvoid.zoltraak.guide: A white flower seal fires a piercing beam. With this spell selected, press the Cycle Zoltraak Mode key (default: Left Shift; rebind in Controls) to cycle Single / Rapid / Large. Large shots break ordinary terrain and split against resistant blocks. In Rapid mode, hold the cast button to keep firing guided shots; continued fire consumes extra mana. Large mode consumes twice the base cast mana.
spell.grandsigil.black_coffin.guide: Speak for four and a half seconds and a field of gravity closes on a piece of ground and takes the shape of a box. Everything sealed inside is pinned where it stands by the weight of it, and anything nearby is dragged toward the walls. Then the lances come: twenty-four of them, driving in through the walls from every side over four seconds, one after another, until the box is a pincushion -- and then it comes apart on whatever is left. It is the only spell here that kills slowly enough to watch, and that is also its weakness: kill the caster while the box is standing and every lance that has not landed yet never does.
spell.grandsigil.caldera.guide: Turn thirty blocks of ground into a volcano for a minute. The floor becomes basalt shot through with veins of magma, and you and everything on your side are given fire resistance -- so the terrain is a floor to you and a slow burn to everybody else. That is the whole spell: the buff and the debuff are one piece of ground read from two sides. You have to stand in it. Where two domains overlap, the one with the higher spell power consumes the other; if they are equal, both casters keep their footing and neither can touch the other. Nothing is destroyed -- every block is written down and put back when the minute is up.
spell.grandsigil.colosseum.guide: Spend a fifth of your health to raise a wall of bone forty-five blocks high around the field -- three tiers of arches, a solid red barrier behind them, and blood running down the whole inside. Nobody inside gets out, and it rains lances on them for fourteen seconds. Everything in there bleeds, half of it heals you, and every death makes the walls take faster. Then it falls in on whatever is left.
spell.grandsigil.crimson_threads.guide: Blood wells up out of the ground round you in streams and gathers twenty-six blocks overhead into a heart, beating. It puts a thread into everything hostile within forty blocks, and for eight seconds it drinks on every beat -- harder the more it has bound -- while a stream of what it drinks pours down into you. At the end every thread snaps, tearing out of what it was in, and the heart comes down and is taken into you: a shield of health, strength, and the blood pushing everything near you away.
spell.grandsigil.dimension_cut.guide: Space goes still and a hairline of light traces itself across where you are looking, ninety blocks long, slanting down into the ground. Then it is cut: a stroke of white light runs the length of it faster than the eye, finer cuts flash round it, and everything on the line is cleaved through whatever it is wearing. The cut opens into a tear in the world, black and full of stars, its lips burning violet, and for three seconds it drags everything near it back onto the line. Then it snaps shut, and the snap is a second cut.
spell.grandsigil.full_bloom.guide: A circle of light opens in the ground and vines of light burst out of it, twisting together into a stem forty-six blocks tall. Leaves unfurl off it, and at the top a bud opens into a flower of light, twenty-two petals in three rings. For nine seconds it sheds pollen in a vast slow vortex out to fifty blocks: everything hostile beneath it is poisoned, slowed and worn down, with a wave of pollen rolling out every two seconds, while you and your allies are healed. Then its heart bursts, and the petals come away one by one and drift off as the stem unravels into light.
spell.grandsigil.geode_heart.guide: The ground cracks in a ring where you are looking and a geode fifty blocks across comes up through it, broken open: a bowl of smooth basalt, calcite and amethyst, jagged at the rim and burst through in places, grown over inside with amethyst -- and over it, turning, a heart of crystal the size of a house. For twelve seconds it beats, once a second, and every beat turns whatever hostile thing is within thirty-four blocks a little further to stone: slower, then rooted where it stands, then barely able to lift its hands, and the amethyst grows on it as it goes. Leave the field and the stone wears off. Then the heart breaks, the geode flies apart, and everything it was turning to stone breaks with it -- harder the further gone.
spell.grandsigil.grand_sigil.guide: Inscribe a ritual circle on the ground under one creature. It is bound inside it and cannot take a step. A second circle then stacks above the first for every rune the incantation reaches -- twelve of them over seven seconds, each a semitone above the last, until a tower ninety blocks tall stands over the thing that cannot move. Then the whole tower falls in on itself, gathers into a single point above it, and goes off. The largest single number in Apex Arcana, on exactly one target. Kill the caster, or kill the target before the twelfth circle, and it collapses without firing.
spell.grandsigil.heaven_gate.guide: Open a gate a hundred and twenty blocks up and let a corridor of light down out of it, wide enough to stand a party in. Inside, allies are mended and enemies burn; the undead are simply not allowed to be there.
spell.grandsigil.ice_age.guide: The sky goes still and an aurora unrolls across it. Out of the cold a blizzard comes down as one vortex seventy blocks tall, flaring at the top into a spiral of driven snow, and frost runs out over the ground to the edge of a field fifty-six blocks across. For nine seconds everything hostile inside it is chilled, slowed and frozen through, while spears of frost fall out of the storm and burst where they land. Then the vortex draws in on itself, dragging everything it caught toward the middle, and at absolute zero the whole field shatters at once -- harder on whatever it managed to freeze solid.
spell.grandsigil.maelstrom.guide: The ground where you are looking goes to water: a whirlpool forty-four blocks across opens under the field, turning, and everything hostile near it is dragged in toward the middle. Then the middle stands up. A waterspout forty-six blocks tall tears out of the whirlpool -- a twisting column of water, narrow at the waist and flaring wide at its head, ropes of current wound up it and spray thrown off it as it turns. Everything hostile within twenty-eight blocks is taken off its feet and carried round and up the spout, battered as it goes, for eight seconds. Then the spout lets go of itself and comes down all at once on the place it stood: a wall of water thrown out thirty-two blocks in every direction, and everything it carried thrown with it.
spell.grandsigil.phoenix.guide: A bird of fire forms in a pillar of flame where you stand and climbs into the sky. It flies two laps over the point you aimed at -- the first wide, the second tight -- and the fire falling from it catches on the ground, so that by the end the target is standing inside two burning rings. Then it pulls up, hangs for a moment at the top of the climb, folds its wings and dives straight into the middle. What rises out of the explosion is the same bird, spreading its wings once more before it comes apart into embers.
spell.grandsigil.reckoning.guide: Spend five seconds making a star small enough to hold. It starts as a mote between your hands and does not stop: gold hoops close in on it, turn around it, and are swallowed by a flood of light you cannot look at directly. Then throw it. Where it lands, a column of light stands on the world -- everything hostile inside is struck once and hard the moment it arrives, and the light is still there for seven seconds afterwards, burning whatever is still standing in it. Undead take two and a half times either. Allies caught in it are given the light instead: regeneration while it stands, and absorption to carry out of it. Break the incantation and the star goes out in your hands.
spell.grandsigil.sea_dragon.guide: A whirlpool opens at your feet and a dragon made of water comes up out of it, climbing round you twice. Then it turns the way you are facing and goes: seventy-two blocks in a second and a half, corkscrewing and gathering speed, its open jaws through everything in the way and the length of it battering whatever it lies across. At the end of its run it dives head first into the ground and breaks there like a wave, throwing everything near it outward.
spell.grandsigil.skybreak.guide: Crack the sky open and strike once through the gap. One bolt, and branches off it reaching every hostile thing in range at the same moment. A roof is the only answer, and the thunder arrives late.
spell.grandsigil.stilled_world.guide: Time stops. A front runs out from you forty blocks in under a second, and everything it passes stops where it is: creatures mid-stride, motes mid-air, the clouds, the sun. The world goes the colour of ice and the sound goes out of it. For eight seconds only you and your allies move. A crystal flower grows round everything that was caught, and anything you hit in stopped time does not feel it yet -- the blow is held, and its crystal cracks a little further. Then every crystal shatters at once, time comes back, and every held blow lands together, on top of the shattering itself.
spell.grandsigil.sunfall.guide: Take hold of the sun. It walks across the sky to noon, gathers, and fires straight down through everything beneath it. Works at midnight -- it does not need the sun to be up, it brings it up.
spell.grandsigil.the_gaze.guide: Open an eye a hundred and twenty blocks across in the sky. Everything hostile beneath it is transfixed: a ring of eyes opens in the air around each of them and watches, and for as long as they are watched they cannot take a step and cannot cast a spell. They can still look around, which is the only thing they get. It deals no damage whatsoever -- it is the one spell here that cannot kill anything, and the one worth casting when you cannot win the damage race. Fourteen seconds of a room that is not in the fight, handed to whoever is standing next to you. Watch it yourself for three seconds and it notices you.
spell.grandsigil.thousand_blades.guide: A wall of sixty-four golden gates opens in the air behind you and the armoury empties itself: a hundred and twenty giant blades over eight seconds, slow at first and then a storm. Each one is drawn out of its gate point first, accelerates, and bends in a long arc toward somebody -- the blades are shared between the sixteen nearest hostile things. Near the end a great gate opens high over the thickest of the crowd, and the king's sword, thirty blocks long, slides out of it and comes down the diagonal into the ground among them. Blades that find their mark stay in the wound; the rest stand in the ground, and all of them turn back into light a few seconds later.
spell.grandsigil.thunder_dragon.guide: A storm a hundred and thirty blocks across gathers over the place you are looking at, and out of its eye comes a dragon of lightning a hundred and fifty blocks long. It swims round under the storm in a vast heaving ring, and every few seconds it turns its head and spits lightning wherever you are looking: twelve strikes, each one wider and harder than the last, catching whatever stands too near. Look at a creature and the lightning finds it; look at the ground and it strikes there. Then it folds out of the ring and dives head first onto the place you are looking at, and the whole length of it pours down into that one point after its head, every coil bursting as it arrives -- until the tail goes in and the storm lets go of everything it has left.
spell.grandsigil.voidgrip.guide: Tear islands of the End into the sky and take hold of everything under them. They come off the ground, rise thirty blocks, and hang there unable to do anything at all for three seconds -- and then the grip drives them straight back into the floor hard enough to hurt whatever they land on. Three quarters of a second to walk out is all the warning there is.
spell.grandsigil.world_tree.guide: Grow a tree through the battlefield. Its roots hold what they catch and its canopy mends what shelters under it -- and everything that dies beneath it feeds it, so it grows a stage taller and reaches a little further, six times over.
spell.grandsigil.worldspine.guide: The ground splits from your feet along the way you are facing, and a mountain range comes up through it: a ridge of rock spires eighty-four blocks long, low beside you and climbing to seventy blocks two thirds of the way out, with lower spires leaning off both flanks and veins of crystal burning in all of them. Whatever stands on the line is thrown into the air as its spire arrives. The range stands for four seconds, grinding at whatever is still among it, and then it comes down on all of it. Nothing in the world is broken: when the dust settles, the mountain is gone.
spell.gtbcs_geomancy_plus.chunker.guide: Summons a large rolling dirt block that moves forward, damaging and knocking back enemies in its path.
spell.gtbcs_geomancy_plus.crystalline_co: Creates a large amethyst cluster that pulses with geo energy, granting Geo Spell Power to the caster while inside its radius. When it resonates with Pillar of the Resounding Earth, it restores mana to the caster.
spell.gtbcs_geomancy_plus.dripstone_bolt: Fires a shard of dripstone that shatters on impact, damaging the target and 50% of its damage in a small area.
spell.gtbcs_geomancy_plus.eroding_boulde: Shoots out a small boulder that explodes on contact, dealing damage to nearby enemies and applying the Erode effect.
spell.gtbcs_geomancy_plus.fissure.guide: Creates a fissure that travels forward, and erupts in a small spike that deals damage.
Summons a small geo pillar that resonates with nearby allies, releasing periodic waves energy. Standing near it grants stacking bonuses to Armor and Spell Resistance to every element. Can serve as the main resonance conductor for Pillar of the Resounding Earth.
spell.gtbcs_geomancy_plus.petrivise.guid: Raises two massive stone walls on opposite sides that slam together, crushing enemies caught between them. The impact funnels targets toward the center, lining them up for follow-up attacks.
spell.gtbcs_geomancy_plus.pillar_of_the_: Summons a large geo pillar that sends out powerful shockwaves, damaging enemies while shredding their Armor and Spell Resistance to every element. The shockwaves resonate with nearby geo entities. Certain geo entities may trigger additional special effects when struck by a resonance shockwave.
spell.gtbcs_geomancy_plus.seismic_surf.g: Summons a large rideable boulder that rises into the air and moves forward on its own in the direction you're looking. Near the end of its duration, it'll safely drop the rider down. Rider can trigger this drop early by casting Counterspell on it.
spell.gtbcs_geomancy_plus.solar_beam.gui: Unleashes a continuous beam of solar energy in a straight line, damaging all entities caught within. Can only be obtained by defeating Umvuthi, The Sunbird.
spell.gtbcs_geomancy_plus.solar_chorus.g: Summons Umvuthana Raptors to fight for you. Each Umvuthana Raptor spawns with 2 Umvuthana Cranes. Can only be obtained from Umvuthana Raptor.
spell.gtbcs_geomancy_plus.solar_storm.gu: Applies an effect that calls continuous sunstrikes onto nearby enemies, damaging them and setting them on fire. Can only be obtained by defeating Umvuthi, The Sunbird.
spell.gtbcs_geomancy_plus.tremor_spike.g: Erupts multiple spikes in expanding rings around the caster, dealing damage and knocking up nearby entities.
spell.gtbcs_geomancy_plus.tremor_step.gu: Applies an effect that deals damage to nearby enemies while sprinting and grants increased movement speed to the caster.
spell.gtbcs_geomancy_plus.weeping_cluste: Creates a unique crying obsidian cluster that stores damage dealt to entities in its radius each 1s. If the stored damage exceeds the cluster’s capacity, or when the cluster expires, it detonates and deals the stored damage in the area.
spell.gtbcs_geomancy_plus.weeping_wall.g: Creates a wall of obsidian by carefully placing multiple pillars, that blocks incoming damage and acts as a shield. When the wall expires or is destroyed, it releases the stored damage in an area around it.
spell.irons_spellbooks.arcane_shackle.gu: Hurl a bundle of arcane chains. Upon hitting a creature, cause three chains to bind it to the ground, each applying a tethering force. On miss, three chains lash out to unique nearby creatures. Chains can be damaged or dispelled.
spell.irons_spellbooks.ball_lightning.gu: Conjure an orb of lightning that slowly moves forward, damaging creatures it phases through and bouncing off blocks.
spell.irons_spellbooks.blizzard.guide: Channel a slow-moving, swirling blizzard at a targeted location, causing freezing wind and snow to pull creatures into the center of the vortex.
spell.irons_spellbooks.cleanse.guide: Pray to a divine magic to cleanse yourself and nearby allies of harmful status effects.
spell.irons_spellbooks.echoing_strikes.g: Non-magical attacks will create an echo, producing a spectral sword to slam down in an area, or a piercing magical arrow to shoot the same target. Echoes do a percent of the original attack's damage.
spell.irons_spellbooks.eldritch_blast.gu: Fire rays of pure, devastating energy.
spell.irons_spellbooks.fang_swirl.guide: Target a creature or block to conjure a spiraling zone of evoker fangs in a radius.
spell.irons_spellbooks.fire_arrow.guide: Aim an arrow made of fiery magic that will deal direct damage on impact and explode for half damage in a small radius around it. It flies straight for a duration before gravity affects it.
spell.irons_spellbooks.flaming_barrage.g: Repeatedly cast to shoot individual small fireballs, which home towards your cursor, or the creature your cursor is targeting.
spell.irons_spellbooks.flaming_strike.gu: Unleash a sweeping melee attack in the form of a wreath of flames. This spell is uninterruptible. The damage scales off of your held weapon's melee damage and enchantments.
spell.irons_spellbooks.frostbite.guide: Imbue yourself with a magical Frostbiting power, making any fully-frozen creature you kill turn into an Ice Shadow. Ice Shadows shatter into icicles after 5 seconds or upon taking any damage.
spell.irons_spellbooks.gluttony.guide: Turn your stomach into an arcane furnace, turning eaten food into mana for a duration.
spell.irons_spellbooks.gravity_fissure.g: Split from the air a miniature Black Hole that moves forward in a line, pulling nearby creatures into its gravity well, but dealing no damage.
spell.irons_spellbooks.ice_spikes.guide: Unleash a cascading line of ice magic, creating ice crystals that emerge from the ground. The final spike does full damage, and will emerge early if a creature within range is targeted.
spell.irons_spellbooks.ice_tomb.guide: Encase yourself in a protective tomb of ice, providing healing while within, absorbing one hit or counterspell before breaking. Dismount to leave the tomb.
Cast to transport yourself into a personal pocket dimension only you can access, giving a small free range area.
spell.irons_spellbooks.portal.guide: Creates two portals that allows players to travel back and forth between them.
spell.irons_spellbooks.raise_hell.guide: Slam down your weapon to wreath a fiery shockwave in a large radius around you. Damage scales based on the held weapon.
spell.irons_spellbooks.recall.guide: Warps you back to your spawn location, or world spawn if there is none.
spell.irons_spellbooks.sacrifice.guide: Target one of your magic summons to cause them to explode, killing them instantly, and dealing large damage in the area around them. The summon's remaining health boosts the damage dealt and radius of explosion.
spell.irons_spellbooks.scapegoat.guide: Conjure a magical decoy in the form of a goat, which takes aggro from nearby hostile mobs and runs off into the distance, taunting them for a duration.
spell.irons_spellbooks.scorch.guide: In a targeted area, erupt a scorch of fiery magic, damaging creatures in the zone and leaving a field of fire.
spell.irons_spellbooks.shadow_slash.guid: Dash forward with a arcing slash of arcane energy, striking creatures in an area. Projectiles hit are deflected. Scales off held weapon's melee damage and enchantments.
spell.irons_spellbooks.shockwave.guide: Coalesce a surge of electrical power, and unleash it in a devastating shockwave, blasting exposed creatures.
spell.irons_spellbooks.snowball.guide: Conjure a giant snowball and throw it forward, bursting into a frosty field and Chilling creatures in a surrounding radius on impact. Chilled creatures become entombed in ice when fully frozen.
spell.irons_spellbooks.stomp.guide: With a magic force, stomp the ground in front of you and send a short tremor forward through the ground, damaging creatures in its path.
spell.irons_spellbooks.summon_swords.gui: Conjure a trio of spectral armaments to aid in battle: a brawling shortsword, a quick rapier, and a tanking claymore. Created by the Ancient Magician known as Hazentouvel.
spell.irons_spellbooks.throw.guide: Cast to throw your held item, dealing a base damage plus damage normally inflicted by the item.
spell.irons_spellbooks.thunderstorm.guid: Cast to conjure a thunderstorm centered around yourself, which strikes nearby creatures within sight with a small bolt of lightning every 2 seconds for the spell's duration.
spell.irons_spellbooks.touch_dig.guide: Use magic to break a block. Held items affect drops.
spell.irons_spellbooks.volt_strike.guide: Leap forward in a spinning voltaic attack, striking the first creature or surface you hit, and dealing a residual blast in a small area around around the impact.
spell.traveloptics.abyssal_blast.guide: Cast to fire a devastating beam of abyssal energy in a straight line. While active, caster cannot move or look around. Can only be found by defeating The Leviathan.
spell.traveloptics.aerial_collapse.guide: Inflict an effect that lifts enemies into the air for 2.5 seconds before crushing them down to the floor, dealing percentage-based damage to their health. The damage dealt ignores any kind of damage cap.
spell.traveloptics.aerial_collapse.imbue: This spell cannot be cast from Imbuements (Use Spellbook)
spell.traveloptics.annihilation.guide: Targets enemies and nukes them with a devastating spell that deals massive damage. Survivors are inflicted with a radiation effect, preventing incoming healing. Can only be  found from Toxic Caves ruins and by slaying Nucleepers.
spell.traveloptics.apex_harvest.guide: Cast to consume up to 5 nearby Soul Apex and recharges the Cursed Wraithblade, instantly switching it into its Apex-Shot mode. Requires Cursed Wraithblade to cast this spell.
spell.traveloptics.apex_harvest.warning: You need Cursed Wraithblade weapon to cast this spell!
spell.traveloptics.aqua_missiles.guide: Fires a rapid succession of water bolts that deal damage and home in on nearby entities.
spell.traveloptics.ashen_breath.guide: Exhale a cloud of darkening ash, damaging and blinding creatures in its reach.
spell.traveloptics.astral_sense.guide: Reveals the pathfinder of nearby entities in a radius. Normal casting alerts the caster about nearby threats, while crouch casting helps sense loot, traps, and valuables like Arcane Debris.
spell.traveloptics.axe_of_the_doomed.gui: Summon a Aptrgangr to fight by your side and unleash devastating melee attacks upon your enemies. Can only be obtained by defeating Aptrgangr.
spell.traveloptics.beast_beneath.guide: Conjure a phantom of Zaevorath from the ground at a random enemy within the radius, biting and dealing damage for the duration of the effect. Can only be obtained by defeating Zaevorath
spell.traveloptics.berserker.guide: Grants the Berserk effect to the caster, providing an immense boost to critical hit rate and damage, but also inflicting the darkness effect on the caster.
spell.traveloptics.blackout.guide: Creates a lingering anti-magic field that suppresses abilities within its radius. Players caught in the zone are unable to cast spells and use items. Moving within the field inflicts small damage. Can only be obtained by defeating the Enraged Dead King.
spell.traveloptics.blink.guide: Low-cost, short-ranged teleport in the direction you're moving. Works omni-directionally.
spell.traveloptics.blood_howl.guide: Cast to shoot wither howitzer projectiles at your target. This spell has recasts.
spell.traveloptics.bubble_spray.guide: Sprays a stream of bubbles that deals damage, slows affected entities, and applies the Wet effect.
spell.traveloptics.burning_judgment.guid: Creates Ignis flame strikes on the ground in a straight line for a duration. If the caster's health falls below 50%, the strikes transform into soul-fired flame strikes. Can only be obtained by defeating Ignis.
spell.traveloptics.call_forth_the_dead_k: Summons an Enraged Dead King boss to challenge you. Defeating it grants a higher chance of obtaining high-quality loot, including the exclusive spell Blackout. The Enraged Dead King can cast additional powerful spells. The high mana cost is intentional to make it only cast-able from scrolls. Can only be found in Catacombs Chests.
Fires a elemental beam in the direction the caster is looking, constantly damaging and piercing targets in its path. Acid Beam applies Radiation on hit - reducing healing rate of the enemies. Hit counts accumulate over the beam's duration, and at its end point - either the max range or the block it hits - a catalytic field of acid is created, blasting enemies and dealing damage based on the beam's accumulated hit count. Can be obtained by defeating Zaevorath or via trading with Fading Mage Fragment #2
Fires a elemental beam in the direction the caster is looking, constantly damaging and piercing targets in its path. Aqua Beam applies Mana Wither on hit - reducing max mana of the enemies, and its damage additionally scales with the caster's Mana Regen. Hit counts accumulate over the beam's duration, and at its end point - either the max range or the block it hits - a catalytic field of water is created, blasting enemies and dealing damage based on the beam's accumulated hit count. Can be obtained by defeating Zaevorath or via trading with Fading Mage Fragment #2
Fires a elemental beam in the direction the caster is looking, constantly damaging and piercing targets in its path. Fire Beam applies Rend on hit - reducing armor of the enemies. Hit counts accumulate over the beam's duration, and at its end point - either the max range or the block it hits - a catalytic field of fire is created, blasting enemies and dealing damage based on the beam's accumulated hit count. Can be obtained by defeating Zaevorath or via trading with Fading Mage Fragment #2
spell.traveloptics.conjure_void_tomes.gu: Summon magical Void Tomes to fight by your side and unleash spell attacks upon your enemies. Can be found in Void Cathedral.
spell.traveloptics.coral_barrage.guide: Cast to mark targets, unleashing a barrage of coral bolts at the end of recasting. Bolts damage, pierce, and shatter into shrapnel, dealing AoE damage within a 2-block radius.
spell.traveloptics.cursed_blast.guide: Channel the essence of darkness, unleashing a cryogenic blast that shatters the resolve of those caught within. Amplified by absorbed soul fragments. Only cast-able from Cursed Wraithblade.
spell.traveloptics.cursed_minefield.guid: On cast, summons Leviathan’s abyssal mines in a radius around the player. The mine placement is random, but they cannot go below the caster’s Y level.
spell.traveloptics.cursed_revenants.guid: Cast to summon random Draugr variants that'll protect you and fight for you.
spell.traveloptics.dead_king_cast.warnin: This spell must be cast directly from scroll!
spell.traveloptics.death_laser.guide: Cast to shoot The Harbinger Laser beam in a straight line. While active, caster cannot move or look around.
spell.traveloptics.descent_of_decay.guid: Opens a portal in the sky and, after a short windup, brings down a giant Radioactive Tree that slams into the target dealing massive impact damage. The tree then decays over-time on the impact site, applying constant damage and applying radiation while it lingers. While Luna Elemental Aspects are full (25), total spell damage is increased by 75%. Requires Reckoning Of The Eternal Hunger to cast this spell.
spell.traveloptics.descent_of_decay.warn: You need Reckoning Of The Eternal Hunger weapon to cast this spell!
spell.traveloptics.despair.guide: Launches a magical Axe Blade forward on the look direction piercing through entities in its path. Deals damage to all caught in its trajectory.
spell.traveloptics.earthshatter.guide: Grants a effect; during that, Right-clicking or holding the ground will raise block that can be shoot by attacking it.
spell.traveloptics.echo_of_the_abyss.gui: Summons a Hullbreaker to fight and protect the caster. Can be used as an underwater mount, granting water breathing while ridden. Can only be obtained from defeating Hullbreaker.
spell.traveloptics.eek.guide: Eek yourself and eek targeted entity.
spell.traveloptics.em_pulse.guide: Cast to stun nearby entities for a short duration. Stunned enemies has a visual indicator.
spell.traveloptics.eternal_sentinel.guid: Conjure a friendly Ender Golem to protect and fight by your side. Can only be obtained by defeating Ender Golem.
spell.traveloptics.extinction.guide: Calls down a massive asteroid, smashing into the ground with incredible force. The impact devastates a large area, leaving a crater that erupts with searing heat, turning all within to ash. Only cast-able from Gauntlet Of Extinction.
spell.traveloptics.flames_reborn.guide: Ignite a wave of fire, marking your place in time. If you fall, the flames will resurrect you at your marked spot, restoring you to the health you had when it was cast.
spell.traveloptics.flood_slash.guide: Unleashes a aqua-infused slash projectile that deals damage and converts damage dealt into Mana for the caster. Hitting multiple entities increases the caster's Mana regeneration temporarily.
spell.traveloptics.floodgate.guide: Imposes a damage cap on the caster, ensuring that any incoming damage exceeding the threshold is reduced to the cap. When damage surpasses the threshold, waves surge outward in all directions, dealing damage.
spell.traveloptics.galena_shatter.guide: Slams the ground with Galena energy, releasing a magnetic shockwave that damages enemies and converts any Scarlet or Azure Charges into corresponding Marks. Marked targets take continuous damage over 1.5s, ignoring i-frames. When the effect ends, a final magnetic burst triggers, pulling opposite-marked entities and pushing away those with the same mark. Requires Galenic Polarizer to cast this spell.
spell.traveloptics.gyro_slash.guide: Transform the Infernal Devastator into Blade Mode, slashing entities in front of you. Using an Infernal Devastator Evo 2 or higher creates a slash projectile that pulls in nearby entities with a fiery vacuum effect before bursting into flame jets. Only cast-able from Infernal Devastator.
spell.traveloptics.gyro_slash.warning: You need Infernal Devastator weapon to cast Gyro Slash!
spell.traveloptics.halberd_horizon.guide: Summons Phantom Halberds in the battlefield around the caster, damaging entities caught in it. Can only be obtained by defeating Maledictus.
spell.traveloptics.herald_of_acropolis.g: Conjures a loyal Clawdian to fight and protect you. Can only be obtained by defeating a Clawdian.
spell.traveloptics.hydroshot.guide: Fires a small water bolt that deals damage, slows enemies, and applies the wet effect.
spell.traveloptics.ignited_onslaught.gui: Cast to summon a Ignited Revenant & Berserker to protect you and fight for you. Can only be obtained by defeating Ignited Revenant and Ignited Berserker.
spell.traveloptics.jet_steam.guide: Generates a powerful surge that propels the caster at high speed while using elytra or swimming underwater, granting temporary water breathing.
spell.traveloptics.jet_steam.warning: You must be swimming or in elytra flight to cast this spell!
spell.traveloptics.lava_bomb.guide: Launches projectiles at a 45° angle in front of the caster, that explodes upon impact, creating lava pools. When cast, the spell absorbs nearby lava.
spell.traveloptics.lingering_strain.guid: Grants a effect; During that any burst damage you get will be split into 4 different smaller damage and will be dealt over time giving the caster time to recover.
spell.traveloptics.magnet.warning: You need Galenic Polarizer weapon to cast this spell!
Cast to deploy a Magnetron that will follow, protect, and fight for you. Can only be obtained by defeating Magnetron.
spell.traveloptics.mechanized_predator.g: Cast to deploy Watchers and The Prowler that will follow, protect, and fight for you. Can only be obtained by defeating The Watcher and The Prowler.
⚠ A tripwire trap is attached nearby!
spell.traveloptics.meteor_storm.guide: Summons Ignis fireballs to rain down from the sky. If the caster's health falls below 50%, the fireballs transform into soul-fired projectiles.
spell.traveloptics.nocturnal_swarm.guide: Cast to summon deadly swarm of Vesper.
spell.traveloptics.not_in_water.warning: You must be underwater to cast this spell!
spell.traveloptics.nullflare.guide: Cast to inflict Nullflare Ice on enemies, or Crouch Cast to inflict Nullflare Fire; when Ice meets Fire, or vice versa, it triggers a Nullflare Blast, dealing damage. Additional effect stacks increase the Blast damage.
spell.traveloptics.orbital_void.guide: Shoots Abyssal Orbs in a circular pattern around the caster. These orbs home in on the nearest enemy, relentlessly tracking and damaging them. Crouch cast to spread orbs across multiple random targets.
spell.traveloptics.overflow.guide: Causes water to erupt from the ground that spreads into a wide pool. The pool continuously applies Aqua Spell Power scaling Wet effect to anything inside it. The Wet effect grows stronger over the spell’s duration, reaching its maximum intensity as the spell ends.
spell.traveloptics.primal_pack.guide: Summon Vallumraptors and Tremorsaurus to fight by your side. Can only be obtained by defeating Vallumraptors and Tremorsaurus.
spell.traveloptics.primordial_steed.guid: Summon a Atlatitan that will follow you around, let you ride. Also protect, and fight for you. Can only be obtained by defeating Luxtructosaurus.
spell.traveloptics.psychic_bolt.guide: Select multiple targets on cast. On recast end, fires small projectiles that confuse targets on hit, making them prioritize attacking nearby non-player entities.
spell.traveloptics.rainfall.guide: Calls down a rainstorm that grants immunity to negative effects for the caster and applies the Wet effect to everyone within.
spell.traveloptics.rapid_laser.guide: Continuously shoots Harbinger's pew-pew laser to targeted entities.
spell.traveloptics.reversal.guide: Reverses any incoming damage with increased power. Additionally, it can copy incoming projectiles.
spell.traveloptics.reversal.warning: You need a suitable weapon to cast Reversal!
spell.traveloptics.rift_of_the_waning_mo: Opens a portal in the sky to bring down a moon, its gravity causing massive tides in the area that damage enemies caught within. After a short delay, the moon explodes dealing damage in a giant radius and applying a curse that deals damage over time for a short duration. Requires Lament Of The Moon to cast this spell
You need maximum amount of Luna Elemental Fuel to cast this spell (100)!
Requires Lament Of The Moon weapon to cast this spell!
spell.traveloptics.serpentide.guide: Summons a cascade of Storm Serpents that strike down in a straight line one after another, dealing damage and applying Wet effect. Damage ignores i-frames. Can only be obtained by defeating Scylla.
spell.traveloptics.shadowed_miasma.guide: Inflicts nearby enemies with the Abyssal Curse effect and infuses you with Abyssal Strike. Your next melee hit deals fixed 40% extra damage and marks the target with Abyssal Curse, spreading it to nearby entities. This can only occur once every 3s. Abyssal Strike grants a fixed 30% Spell Crit Rate bonus, while spell damage against cursed enemies gains a fixed 50% bonus Spell Crit Damage.
spell.traveloptics.shear_of_the_stars.gu: Summons a Dragon Spirit that flies forward, passing through blocks and damaging enemies it hits. It leaves behind a Stellar Trail that deals damage over time to nearby enemies. Dragon damage ignores I-Frames. Requires Stellothorn to cast this spell.
spell.traveloptics.shear_of_the_stars.wa: You need Stellothorn weapon to cast this spell!
spell.traveloptics.skypiercer.guide: Calls down a phantom Trident Of Eternal Maelstrom from the sky, dealing impact damage in an area. The trident remains, pulsing for 50% of the impact damage at intervals and inflicting Tidal Torment, causing thrown Trident Of Eternal Maelstrom to explode in an area and slowing affected enemies. Requires Trident Of The Eternal Maelstrom to cast this spell.
spell.traveloptics.skypiercer.warning: Requires Trident Of The Eternal Maelstrom weapon to cast this spell!
spell.traveloptics.spectral_blink.guide: After activation, the caster has 3 seconds. During this time, they can teleport to any entity they are looking at, even through walls. Any entities within the teleportation range will be revealed to the caster.
spell.traveloptics.stele_cascade.guide: Summons Ancient Desert Stele in a radius, crashing down and dealing damage.
spell.traveloptics.sticky_steed_summon.g: Conjure a Gum Worm that will follow you around, let you ride. Also protect, and fight for you. Can only be obtained by defeating Gum Worm.
spell.traveloptics.summon_behemoth.warni: You already have an active Behemoth summon!
spell.traveloptics.summon_desert_dweller: Summon Koboletons and Wadjet to fight by your side. Can only be obtained by defeating Koboletons and Wadjet.
spell.traveloptics.summon_elite.warning: An Elite summon is already active!
spell.traveloptics.summon_group.warning: You already have a Group summon active!
spell.traveloptics.supernova.guide: Summon a collapsing star that builds in intensity over time. After a short delay, it erupts in a massive explosion, dealing heavy damage and gives birth to a supermassive black hole. The black hole pulls in nearby entities and continues to deal damage within its radius. Requires Wand of Final Light to cast this spell.
spell.traveloptics.supernova.warning: Requires Wand Of Final Light to cast this spell!
spell.traveloptics.sword_of_the_ancients: Summon kobolediator to fight by your side and unleash devastating melee attacks upon your enemies. Can only be obtained by defeating Kobolediator.
spell.traveloptics.tectonic_rift.warning: You need Gauntlet Of Extinction weapon to cast this spell!
spell.traveloptics.the_forgotten_beast.g: Summon Forsaken, a powerful, rideable creature that fight alongside you. However, beware: its will is not fully tameable, and its ferocity may prove unpredictable. Can only be obtained by defeating Forsaken.
spell.traveloptics.the_howling_tempest.g: After a 3s charge, conjures a raging tempest that rains down water spears, dealing damage and applying Wet effect. Each hit has a 50% chance to either increase the Wet amplifier (up to 10x) or extend its duration by 2s. Can only be obtained by defeating Scylla.
spell.traveloptics.tidal_grasp.guide: Pulls a targeted entity toward the caster, striking them with force to deal damage while applying a Stun and the Wet effect.
spell.traveloptics.tidal_slash.guide: Unleashes a Flood Slash projectile that travels forward, dealing damage and restoring mana to the caster. When wielding the Trident of the Eternal Maelstrom (Evo 2 or 3), normal attacks generate multiple weaker slashes that deal reduced damage and restore less mana. Requires Trident Of The Eternal Maelstrom to cast this spell.
spell.traveloptics.tsunami.guide: Call forth an unstoppable tide that surges forward, slamming into enemies, dealing damage, sweeping them away, and applying wet effect.
spell.traveloptics.vigor_siphon.guide: Cast to connect with your nearest summon. Damage dealt by the summon heals you, and your damage heals the summon in return. If you die while tethered, the linked summon is sacrificed to restore you with 8hp
spell.traveloptics.violent_skreech.guide: Continuously pulsate sound blast to Shred Armor, Damage Nearby enemies and Applying Chilled effect. 2% of damage deal converted into lifesteal.
spell.traveloptics.void_devourer.guide: Creates a Dimensional Rift that pulls everything around it and damages enemies caught in it.
spell.traveloptics.void_eruption.guide: Shoots Void Howitzer Projectiles that explode and summon void runes in a radius. This spell can be recast.
spell.traveloptics.vortex_of_the_deep.gu: Conjures a massive water vortex that pulls entities toward its center, slowing them and applying Wet effect. The vortex periodically discharges Boltstrikes to devastate those within it's radius.
spell.traveloptics.vortex_punch.guide: Create a Void Vortex, pulling enemies in. Teleport into it and unleash a crushing uppercut, dealing damage and sending foes flying upward.
spell.zoltraak_cinematic.corrupted_barra: Manifests 24 dark singularity circles, continuously firing dark matter thorns that dissolve barriers and wither enemies.
spell.zoltraak_cinematic.corrupted_zoltr: Qual's original forbidden spell. Releases a superdense Event-Horizon void beam with electric magenta flares that pierces armor and withers life.
spell.zoltraak_cinematic.defense.desc: Standard defensive magic of modern mages. Instantly deploys a hexagonal honeycomb barrier (directional aegis or 360-degree dome when sneaking) that protects the caster while allowing offensive spells to be cast simultaneously.
spell.zoltraak_cinematic.flight.desc: Mankind's reverse-engineered flight magic (人類の魔法). Grants free 3D omnidirectional flight while continuously consuming mana. Flying higher or faster causes mana consumption to skyrocket exponentially.
spell.zoltraak_cinematic.gargantua.desc: Manifests an abyssal gravitational singularity born from supreme mana compression. Bends the geometry of space-time, inexorably pulling all matter and spellcraft past the event horizon before detonating in a cataclysmic cosmic rupture.
spell.zoltraak_cinematic.zoltraak.desc: Ordinary Offensive Magic (人類の魔法). Unleashes an ultra-realistic, hypersonic piercing photonic beam with devastating 10-block terminal shockwave and HDR bloom.
spell.zoltraak_cinematic.zoltraak_barrag: Manifests a grand 24-circle celestial matrix, continuously unleashing rapid volleys of converging guided Zoltraak light lances at the target point.

text.autoconfig.fastquit.option.allowMul:
When this option is enabled, you can join a new world while the old one is still saving.
This is safe to do in vanilla Minecraft, but some mods may have issues when 2 servers run at the same time.
text.autoconfig.fastquit.option.backgrou:
Sets the thread priority of the server when saving worlds in the background.
This is done to improve client performance while saving, but will make the saving take longer over all.
text.autoconfig.fastquit.option.renderSa:
When playing on high render distance, quitting the world can still take a bit because the client-side chunk storage has to be cleared.
By enabling this setting the "Saving world" screen will be rendered.
text.autoconfig.fastquit.option.showSavi: Determines whether the time it took/takes to save the world gets displayed on toasts and the world list.
text.autoconfig.fastquit.option.showToas: Determines whether a toast gets shown when a world finishes saving.
text.autoconfig.fastquit.title: FastQuit

text.entityculling.blockEntityFrustumCul: When turned on, block entity state extraction will be culled based on the camera's view frustum. This can improve performance in case your modloader/another mod doesn't do this already.
text.entityculling.disableF3.tooltip: When turned on, the F3 debug info will not show culling information.
text.entityculling.forceDisplayCulling.t: When turned on, display entities without a bounding box will get assigned a default bounding box for culling purposes. This can improve performance for maps/servers that do not configure their display entities correctly, but can cause visual issues.
text.entityculling.renderNametagsThrough: When turned off, culled entities will not have their nametags rendered through walls.
text.entityculling.skipBlockEntityCullin: When turned on, culling of block entities will be skipped entirely. This can be useful for debugging or when you want to disable culling temporarily.
text.entityculling.skipEntityCulling.too: When turned on, culling of entities will be skipped entirely. This can be useful for debugging or when you want to disable culling temporarily.
text.entityculling.solidLeaves.tooltip: When turned on, leaves will be treated as solid for culling purposes. This can improve performance in forests, but also cause visual issues. Useful when setting 'See-Through Leaves' to Off, or using a bushy leaves resource pack.
text.entityculling.tab.block_entity_cull: Block entities selected in this tab will not be culled at all. This is mainly needed for block entities that need to be rendered regardless of their visibility.
text.entityculling.tab.entity_culling.to: Entities selected in this tab will not be culled at all. This is mainly needed for client-side entities or entities that need to be rendered regardless of their visibility.
text.entityculling.tab.tick_culling.tool: Entities selected in this tab will not have their tick method optimized when culled. This can be useful for entities that need to tick for certain functionality, such as Boats.
text.entityculling.tickCulling.tooltip: When turned on, entities that are culled will not tick. This can improve performance in some cases, but may cause issues with certain mods. Consider the finer control options in the other tab.

text.trender.sendstacktraces.tooltip: When enabled, stacktraces in the log or game crashes that contain mod references to mods by tr7zw will be sent to the mod author via Sentry (Sentry.io) to help fix bugs faster. No personal information is collected or sent. (Restart the game after turning it on)
text.trender.style.tooltip: Changes the UI Style for all of mods by tr7zw.

tooltip.epicawaken_grappling_hook.grappl: • Entity: Pulls the player toward the target by default. Press the grappling hook key again before hitting an entity to pull the target toward the player instead.
A brief prompt appears after hitting an entity. Press the grappling hook key again during the prompt to pull the target toward the player instead.
• Ground: Pulls the player to the target and starts a slide on arrival.
• Miss: No pulling effect is triggered.
• Wall: Pulls the player toward the target;
if a safe position exists above the wall, pulls the player there instead.
tooltip.epicawaken_grappling_hook.phanto: • Short press into air: Pulls the player toward the airborne target.
• Hold while grounded: Swing mode does not activate.
• Short press: Ground, wall, and entity hooks behave like the normal hook.
• Hold while airborne: Swings around the target point.
tooltip.epicfight_dd.amber: One might think this stone had captured the sun, as it looks as though it’s glowing a bright orange.
tooltip.epicfight_dd.big_stick: This is just a normal stick, right?
tooltip.epicfight_dd.blood_knife: These knives were used in the past by the Blood Cult. Because of their light weight and the properties of the blade, these knives were very popular. This popularity reached such a point that the gemstones from which the blade is made no longer exist today.
tooltip.epicfight_dd.blood_ritus_dagger_: This was once a sacred weapon, forged from mithril, but it was misused for cruel rituals by high-ranking figures in the Blood Cult.
This weapon restores health to the wielder when they take another’s life.
tooltip.epicfight_dd.bonecutting_saw_tex: "Tantum qui viam mali ambulant ei digni erunt."

This weapon was primarily used by the Eques Mortis as an instrument of execution. After the Revolution, these weapons became a symbol of atrocity and were subsequently banned. Nevertheless, some of these examples are still in circulation today.
tooltip.epicfight_dd.gloria: As great and mighty as it was, one day it was swallowed up by the maw of hell and abandoned by all the gods, only this relic remained...
tooltip.epicfight_dd.glorious_charm: It is said that the talisman is constructed from orichalcum, an alloy forged many thousands of years ago by a lost civilisation.
tooltip.epicfight_dd.grimm: The metal still seems to be glowing in certain places, even though this weapon is probably thousands of years old!
tooltip.epicfight_dd.hookclaws:
Weapon worn on the fist comprised of sharp parallel blades favored by those who lurk in the dark.

Claws can be equipped in both Hands.
tooltip.epicfight_dd.horus_fang: This weapon was used primarily by the Horus Watchers, who ruled the desert long ago.
tooltip.epicfight_dd.iron_fist:
This weapon was used for torture by the dungeon guards of the old kingdom.
The pointed prongs make it look like a fist-sized version of the Iron Maiden.
tooltip.epicfight_dd.iudex_gundyr_halber:
Halberd of Gundyr the Champion, received when he was charged with his duty.

This old cast-iron halberd has the power to break poise, and is said to never crumble, seeming to suggest that Gundyr was fated to eternal service from the beginning.
tooltip.epicfight_dd.malachite: Parents place these stones under their children’s pillows to protect them from nightmares.
tooltip.epicfight_dd.metal_plate: You’re not sure what materials this piece is made of, but there must be plenty of various materials.
tooltip.epicfight_dd.milady_lore:
A light greatsword; that is, a sword whose blade matches the length of a greatsword, while being constrained to a minimal weight.
Nicknamed after ladies of noble status for its refined appearance. With cultivated form, one can wield this weapon as swiftly as one might a straight sword.
tooltip.epicfight_dd.nailbat: It is lightly smeared with blood...
tooltip.epicfight_dd.night_ritus_dagger_: Like its counterpart, this weapon was forged from mithril, but under the influence of moonlight. It was therefore consecrated to Nox Obscura, the goddess of darkness. What became of this dagger afterwards, no one knows.
This weapon restores stamina when you execute a target. This effect is more effective in moonlight.
tooltip.epicfight_dd.nightingale: The blade of this spear is made of pure electrum, also known as water gold. The shaft itself is made of volcanic glass. Nightingale once belonged to a High Magistrate of the Night Cult.
tooltip.epicfight_dd.peridot: Bright green, but no more dangerous than a pebble
tooltip.epicfight_dd.poleblade_blade_par: It appears to be part of an ancient weapon
tooltip.epicfight_dd.poleblade_text1: This weapon was used by the Blood Cult’s elite soldiers during the Unholy War. After that, it vanished without a trace and was never found…
tooltip.epicfight_dd.revenant: Buried deep within the catacombs now lies what was once forged in brilliant light. Yet after all these years of oblivion, this weapon is still fit for use.
tooltip.epicfight_dd.ruby: This deep wine-red stone seems to absorb all light.
tooltip.epicfight_dd.rusted_metal_plate: This piece of metal is so badly rusted that it is no longer suitable for forging. However, there may be other uses for it.
tooltip.epicfight_dd.saber: Following reunification, a neutral party was established to uphold peace. To meet this challenge, they were entrusted with sacred sabres, whose ornamentation embodies the imagery of justice.
tooltip.epicfight_dd.scythe: It is a rather old scythe that was once used on farms. However, the blade appears to have been reinforced.
tooltip.epicfight_dd.vitreus: The blade of this weapon is so transparent that you might think it were made of glass. There is a glowing, bright-red ruby on the hilt.

tooltip.farm_and_charm.dungarees_3: Shows Feeding Level of Farm Animals

tooltip.relics.acid_walker.ability.walki: For a certain period, allows movement across acid surfaces without sinking into them or sustaining corrosion. After the duration ends, it begins to leave behind a toxic trail, applying acid effects to all living beings.
tooltip.relics.acid_walker.description: Allows its owner to safely traverse acidic surfaces, neutralizing harmful effects and providing protection. Grants access to explore radiation hazard zones, making the insurmountable surmountable.
tooltip.relics.amphibian_boot.ability.gi: Grants player the ability to not consume air while underwater.
tooltip.relics.amphibian_boot.ability.sl: Increases movement speed in the rain depending on its duration.
tooltip.relics.arrow_quiver.ability.leap: Knocks the player away from the looking direction, inflicting a vanishing effect until landing. Using a bow will suspend the player in mid-air, increasing damage and nullifying gravity for the next critical shot.
tooltip.relics.arrow_quiver.ability.rain: Calls on a point along the line of sight an area of falling homing arrows from the internal quiver storage from the «Arrow Storage» ability. The arrows themselves from the storage are not consumed. Only one area from this ability can exist at a time.
tooltip.relics.axolotl_cream.description: A light pink cream. Enhances healing and smells like strawberries.
tooltip.relics.biojoint.ability.cyberpsy:
Killing an enemy has a chance to trigger cyberpsychosis for a set duration.
The chance and duration stacks with other Cyberware with this ability.
Cyberpsychosis: Significantly improves Cyberware abilities but erodes sanity, making the familiar foreign.
tooltip.relics.biojoint.ability.suspensi:
Reduces damage based on the amount taken. The maximum reduction is achieved when the damage taken is equal to users max health or more.
While Cyberpsychosis is active: Damage reduction is always at maximum.
If multiple copies are equipped, damage reduction cannot exceed 50%.
tooltip.relics.biojoint.description: A high-tech joint implant that absorbs impact and reduces damage, providing extra protection against physical stress.
tooltip.relics.bionic_eye.ability.cyberp:
Killing an enemy has a chance to trigger cyberpsychosis for a set duration.
The chance and duration stacks with other Cyberware with this ability.
Cyberpsychosis: Significantly improves Cyberware abilities but erodes sanity, making the familiar foreign.
tooltip.relics.bionic_eye.ability.seeker:
When activated, applies Glowing and Vulnerability effects on enemies in a block radius for a set duration.
While cyberpsychosis is active: Has reduced cooldown and applies increased Vulnerability.
tooltip.relics.bionic_eye.description: A high-tech eye implant that grants the wearer the ability to seek and track targets, highlighting them even through obstacles.
tooltip.relics.converging_orb.ability.co: Every time the user is hit the orb undergoes permanent compression, decreasing its size and dramatically increasing its density.
tooltip.relics.converging_orb.descriptio: A rather heavy orb made from an unknown material which permanently compresses under pressure.
tooltip.relics.crown_of_the_legend.abili:
Grants life-steal scaling with damage and missing health.
 (1-(Current Health)/(Maximum Health)) * Damage * (Life-Steal)
Increases your damage against pig based mobs.
tooltip.relics.crown_of_the_legend.descr: This crown embodies courage. Those who wear it inherit the legacy of a true legend, unshaken in the face of any challenge.
tooltip.relics.depleted_spool.ability.re: The spool's powers can be restored by holding the required items while wearing it, reawakening its ability to regenerate reality-altering threads.
tooltip.relics.depleted_spool.descriptio: Once able to regenerate threads that could alter reality, this spool has lost its power. Now silent and empty, it stands as a relic of forgotten potential.
Each attack the wearer makes with a certain chance summons a phantom blade, dealing a fraction of the original damage to the target.
Invokes several phantom blades, alternately dealing the target a fraction of the weapon's damage from the hand.
tooltip.relics.desolate_pendant.descript: Wields ghostly knives, stealthily piercing targets in the path of its wearer.
tooltip.relics.eject_button.ability.nope: Grants speed when the user's health is low.
tooltip.relics.eject_button.description: A yellow box with a red, glowing button. Engineered for "heroic and tactical" retreats.
tooltip.relics.epoch_apple.ability.persi: The apple recovers to its full form after of being eaten.
tooltip.relics.epoch_apple.ability.ripen: The apple ripens into greater quality after a while of being in its full form.
tooltip.relics.epoch_apple.description: An ancient apple believed to be from the earliest generations of its kind. Its regenerative abilities allow it to recover from severe damage which is how it has survived through the ages.
tooltip.relics.frost_robe.ability.freeze: Each time the wearer receives damage, it has a chance to use the «Frost Spikes» ability and applies a cumulative frostbite effect to the attacker.
tooltip.relics.frost_robe.ability.icicle: Scatters a random number of icicles in a random direction, causing damage to targets.
tooltip.relics.frost_robe.ability.warmin: Prevents frostbite and allows you to walk on blocks of powder snow.
tooltip.relics.frost_robe.description:
+1 experience point for each «Frost Spikes» ability activation.
+1 experience point for each hit with an icicle from the ability «Frost Spikes».
tooltip.relics.gravitum_glove.ability.al: Multiplies attack damage but reduces attack speed by 66%.
tooltip.relics.gravitum_glove.ability.bo:
Attacks over 20 damage (before armor) have a chance to trigger a heavy strike, dealing 2X damage and inflicting Dazed for a duration.
Dazed enemies have a chance to miss their attacks.
tooltip.relics.gravitum_glove.descriptio: A glove which is made from a unique cloth-like material that anchors itself to its current position, making it very hard to move. When it collides with an object it transfers a massive amount of energy, creating a powerful impact even at low speed.
Reduces your gravity. Fall damage and safe fall distance are adjusted accordingly.
Jumping after crouching for one second launches you upwards. You take reduced fall damage from this jump.
tooltip.relics.gravitum_strider.descript: A boot that uses a Gravitum engine to reduce the effects of gravity. It was commonly used by astronauts for training before the severe health risks of Gravitum were discovered.
tooltip.relics.guts_orb.ability.guts.des: If you are under a negative effect or on fire, deal extra damage.
tooltip.relics.guts_orb.description: A flawless orb with stark white corners, its center a deep purple that seems to pulse with a quiet, simmering anger. It radiates an unsettling aura, as if it harbors a grudge.
tooltip.relics.holy_locket.ability.belie: A toggleable ability with two modes: Sanctity and Unholiness. Activating the ability in any mode fills the internal buffer by 1 unit. In Sanctity mode, redirects a portion of the bearer's healing as damage to nearby targets and reduces incoming damage by 1% per charge. In Unholiness mode, absorbs a portion of the healing of nearby targets and increases damage dealt by 1% per charge.
tooltip.relics.holy_locket.ability.bless: Grants the bearer temporary invincibility upon activation, consuming charges from the relic's internal buffer each second.
tooltip.relics.holy_locket.ability.repen: Burns the health of nearby undead.
tooltip.relics.king_crimson.ability.epit: Distorts time and space, rewinding you to your position from 10 seconds ago. Then goes on cooldown.
tooltip.relics.king_crimson.ability.talk:
Your attacks disrupt your target's mind, applying Weakness and Slowness with a chance for several seconds. If the target is another player Static is also applied for half the duration.
Your first attack after Epitaph always triggers this effect.

Static makes players unable to see other mobs and players while it is active.
tooltip.relics.king_crimson.ability.the_: The Court Of The Crimson King

When you attack, if your maximum health is more than or equal to your target's maximum health and their health is below a threshold, they are instantly executed. If your target has more maximum health than you they instead take double damage below this threshold.
tooltip.relics.king_crimson.description: Freed souls burst out of the mask, changing its color and leaving a strange hole in the middle. When you look into the hole you can't see the bottom but the other side looks solid.
tooltip.relics.made_in_heaven.ability.as:
Made in Heaven channels its power into you, increasing all your stats.
Hitting an enemy grants Accelerating, stacking up to 10 times. Each stack increases all stats except health by 0.03X. Gaining stacks has a  cooldown and all stacks expire after a short duration of not attacking.
tooltip.relics.made_in_heaven.ability.co:
Upon activation, unleash holy fire in a cone, dealing damage, burning enemies, and applying Charred.
Charred causes affected enemies to take 1 additional damage per level from all sources.
tooltip.relics.made_in_heaven.ability.di:
Upon activation, rise into the air and after a short delay engulf everything within a 7-block radius in holy fire, dealing damage over 5 seconds in 5 increasing hits and burning enemies. The final 3 hits also apply and stack Charred.
You gain 75% damage reduction while casting this ability.
This ability requires 10 Accelerating stacks to cast.
tooltip.relics.made_in_heaven.ability.ze: While at 10 Accelerating stacks, gain an additional stat boost and automatically revive with half your maximum health upon death. Reviving consumes all Accelerating stacks and triggers a cooldown.
tooltip.relics.made_in_heaven.descriptio: The amulet has unlocked its full potential, transforming into its true form. It now seems to share a bond with you.
tooltip.relics.mass_gauntlet.ability.hea: Your attacks deal a percentage of your maximum health as extra damage with a small cooldown.
tooltip.relics.mass_gauntlet.description: A gauntlet with a massive iron ball affixed to it, designed to force the user's body to move in sync with their strikes. This unique design amplifies the power of each attack as the user's weight is channeled into every blow.
tooltip.relics.moodworm.ability.moody.de:
The worm changes its mood every 10 minutes, providing different benefits:
Furious: Increases damage and attacks burn enemies.
Joyful: Increases speed and luck.
Gloomy: Reduces damage taken and increases resistance to knockback.
tooltip.relics.moodworm.ability.tranquil:
The worm can switch to a new mood.
Tranquil: Provides all the advantages of the worm's other moods.
tooltip.relics.moodworm.description: A symbiotic worm that manipulates its host's emotions, helping them adapt and thrive in shifting conditions.
tooltip.relics.opal_necklace.ability.bub: Protects from all damage once, then goes on cooldown.
tooltip.relics.opal_necklace.description: A silver necklace adorned with a small opal stone, traditionally gifted to travelers and soldiers venturing into barren lands, symbolizing a wish for their safety and protection.
tooltip.relics.polar_boot.ability.polari: Switches the polarity of the boot between blue and red. Red increases the force of attraction to the ground, while blue allows you to levitate freely above its surface.
tooltip.relics.polar_boot.description: Provides the wearer with the ability to levitate above the surface, making it easier to traverse difficult terrain and push the boundaries of exploration.
tooltip.relics.rage_glove.ability.phlebo: Increases the wearer's attack and movement speed, as well as granting passive regeneration proportional to the percentage of the missing health.
Dashes towards the direction of sight, setting enemies on fire, applying bleeding and attacking each target in its path with the item in the hand. Deals additional damage proportional to the number of charges in the relic's internal buffer from the «Berserker's Rage» ability and devastates it.
tooltip.relics.relic.reset.locked: To use you need to level-up this ability at least 1 time.
tooltip.relics.relic.upgrade.locked: The ability has reached its max level.
Ability quality, similar to relic quality, is the arithmetic average of all the ability's current characteristics and is measured in points from 1 to 5 with a step of 0.5. It is purely a visual metric that shows how close the ability's initial random characteristics are to the best possible. To improve the ability's quality, you need to reset its random characteristics until you get a better value.
tooltip.relics.researching.general.level: Earned when leveling up the relic and used to upgrade abilities.
tooltip.relics.researching.relic.card.lo: You need to upgrade the relic to level %1$s to use this!
tooltip.relics.researching.relic.card.no: This ability has no upgradeable stats and does not affect the relic's quality!
tooltip.relics.researching.relic.card.re: This ability is ready to be upgraded!
tooltip.relics.researching.relic.experie: Earned by using the relic's abilities for their intended purpose, as well as gaining experience from other relics. When the maximum experience value is reached, the relic level and leveling points increase by 1, allowing you to unlock previously unavailable abilities or upgrade existing ones.
tooltip.relics.researching.relic.info.ex: Relic quality is the arithmetic average of all currently unlocked abilities' quality and is measured in points from 1 to 5 with a step of 0.5. It is purely a visual metric that shows how close the item's initial random characteristics are to the best possible. To improve the overall quality of the relic, each ability needs to be considered separately.
tooltip.relics.runic_plate.ability.blood: If you also have Swiftedge equipped, Head Start's boosted attack count is increased by 50%.
tooltip.relics.runic_plate.ability.head_:
Upon entering combat, the damage of the first few attacks you take is reduced.

You are considered out of combat if you haven't dealt or taken damage for 15 seconds.
tooltip.relics.runic_plate.ability.peace: You restore health per second while out of combat. This healing can overheal you.
tooltip.relics.runic_plate.description: A rune-carved plate forged by Stafir of the legendary twin smiths. It is said to be able to block not just physical blows, but fate itself.
tooltip.relics.sentient_rust.ability.cor: Applies an armor-corroding effect. Consecutive hits refresh the duration and stack the effect (up to 10 times). Each stack reduces armor by %5.
tooltip.relics.sentient_rust.description: A cluster of Ferro Comedenti fungi, a rare species of fungus which rapidly corrodes metal on contact. Commonly known as 'Sentient Rust' for its reddish hue.
The cape covers your weak spots, increasing your armor by a percentage.
The cape hardens upon impact, blocking the hit with [(Flat Chance) + (Per Armor) * armor]% chance. (max 33%).

tooltip.relics.slumbering_amulet.ability: While wearing the amulet, thoughts of Nether Stars fill your mind, and visions of them appear in your dreams. A strong urge to hold one begins to rise within you.

tooltip.relics.spore_sack.ability.multip: Each spore can split into several smaller spores within a given range when it explodes. The maximum number of spores is determined by the degree of the main spore size, but the final number is limited by the first unsuccessful chance of spore division.

tooltip.relics.thermoseismic_heart.abili:

The chance and duration stacks with other Cyberware with this ability.

Explosions do not harm the user and instead grant a stack of Overload, with a maximum of 4 stacks.

When activated, it releases a stream of heat in a block radius, dealing damage. Stacks of Overload are consumed to amplify the fire's power and range.

tooltip.relics.tyrant_mask.ability.futil: The souls trapped within the mask carry the sorrow of a life spent without leaving a lasting mark. Maybe building with them will help soothe their need to create.

tooltip.relics.tyrant_mask.ability.reven: The souls trapped within the mask crave for revenge against the monsters that slayed them. Perhaps hunting monsters with them could soothe their fury.
tooltip.relics.tyrant_mask.description: A brass mask once worn by a forgotten tyrant. Though his soul is long gone the mask still brims with malice, drawing restless spirits and trapping them within its dark influence.
tooltip.relics.vertebrax.ability.acquire: Completely converts Poison into Regeneration for its full duration.

withered_beacon.info:
The Withered Beacon will apply the selected effect to all nearby players in a very large radius.

In order to activate the Withered Beacon, a 3x3 square of lapis blocks must be constructed directly below it. Then, more layers of any valid beacon base blocks can be added in a pyramid shape to increase the strength of the selected effect.

Withered Support Beacons can be connected and will apply effects from an infinite distance in the direction the connecting beam makes. To connect a support beacon, make a 3x3 square directly underneath the beacon of either emerald, diamond, redstone, or iron blocks. Make sure the support beacon is within 5 blocks of the main beacon. There can only be one of each color and a maximum of four can be connected.
